newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiei shares up on Japan Securities announcement.
newsitem.headline: Daiei shares up on Japan Securities announcement.

text.p: Shares of supermaket chain operator Daiei Inc rose on the Tokyo Stock Exchange early on Thursday morning due to Japan Securities Finance Co Ltd announcement on Wednesday that it may have to limit or suspend fresh lending of Daiei shares in due course.
By 0050 GMT, Daiei shares were up 49 yen at 911 yen.
"Daiei shares are rising because of the alert for possible lending problems," a dealer at a medium-sized trading house said.

Japan Securities Finance, which lends shares to brokerages whose clients wish to sell them short in margin transactions, said on Wednesday it was putting Daiei shares on alert for possible lending problems in the future.
Such warnings reflect outstanding positions of the shares in the loan market and in margin transactions, and have nothing to do with the business performance of the company concerned.
